output.rationale: The requirement specifies metal-clad switchgear with a BIL rating of 95kV. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is described as arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the requirement. This product is offered as engineered-to-order (ETO), suitable for the specific technical needs of the Syracuse Airport Specification.
